app_short: Please implement a website for generating stock reports to provide stock information and analysis.

similar_websites.name: Koyfin
similar_websites.what_it_does: Koyfin is a financial data and analytics platform that lets investors build customizable dashboards, screen stocks across 100K+ global securities, and generate client-ready reports with advanced charting and macro data.

interesting_features.description: Users can change the color theme of the entire interface (light/dark/custom) and rearrange dashboard panels to match their personal workflow. This makes the tool feel tailored rather than generic.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a dark mode toggle to the report page so users can switch between light and dark themes when viewing or generating reports.

interesting_features.description: A powerful screener lets users filter thousands of stocks using hundreds of criteria simultaneously (P/E ratio, sector, market cap, dividend yield, etc.) before selecting one to generate a report on.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a stock screener panel that lets users filter stocks by sector, market cap range, or P/E ratio before selecting one to generate a report.

interesting_features.description: Users can search all earnings call transcripts for specific keywords (e.g., 'AI', 'supply chain') to surface qualitative sentiment signals alongside quantitative data in reports.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an 'Earnings Call Highlights' section to the generated report that surfaces recent management commentary from earnings transcripts for the selected stock.

interesting_features.description: Koyfin allows financial advisors to package dashboards and data views into shareable, professionally formatted reports suitable for sending to clients.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a PDF export button that renders the generated stock report as a downloadable, print-friendly PDF document.

similar_websites.name: Simply Wall St
similar_websites.what_it_does: Simply Wall St provides institutional-grade visual stock research reports for 120,000 global stocks, using distinctive snowflake visualizations and narrative-based analysis to make complex financial data accessible to retail investors.

interesting_features.description: Each stock gets a distinctive pentagon 'snowflake' chart scoring it across five dimensions (value, future growth, past performance, financial health, dividends), giving users an instant visual summary before reading detailed data.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a radar/spider chart to the generated report that scores the stock across key dimensions like valuation, growth, profitability, financial health, and dividend quality.

interesting_features.description: Users can select which sections to include in a stock report (past performance, valuation, growth forecasts, financial health, dividends, insider transactions), so the output matches their specific research goals.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add checkboxes to let users select which sections to include in their generated report (e.g., only show 'Financial Data' and 'Market Trends' and omit 'Insider Transactions').

interesting_features.description: Users can add stocks to a watchlist and receive email or push notifications when key events occur (earnings release, valuation change, dividend cut), keeping reports current without manual re-generation.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Save to Watchlist' button on the report page so users can track a stock and get notified when significant changes occur to its price or financials.

interesting_features.feature: Investing themes and curated stock lists
interesting_features.description: Pre-built thematic collections (e.g., 'AI stocks', 'dividend aristocrats', 'insider buying') let users discover stocks by narrative or trend rather than searching by ticker, lowering the barrier to report generation.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Trending Stocks' or 'Popular Searches' section to the search bar that surfaces commonly searched tickers and thematic categories to help users discover stocks to research.

app_short: Please implement a web-based neighborhood mapping application for comparing data across different areas.

similar_websites.name: NeighborhoodScout
similar_websites.what_it_does: A comprehensive neighborhood intelligence platform that provides address-level demographic, crime, real estate, school, and economic data for every US neighborhood, with predictive analytics and neighborhood-matching tools.

interesting_features.description: Users enter criteria (lifestyle preferences, demographics, budget) and the platform scores every neighborhood against those criteria using 200+ data elements, returning ranked best-match areas. This turns the raw comparison data into a guided recommendation engine.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a neighborhood comparison score card that lets users weight each data category (demographics, crime, economy) with sliders, then auto-ranks the displayed neighborhoods by a weighted composite score.

interesting_features.description: Rather than showing only current or historical snapshots, the platform projects future neighborhood trajectories — useful for investment decisions. It layers time-series trend lines onto the existing data dashboard.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a trend chart panel to the dashboard that shows a selected neighborhood's crime or economic indicator over the past 5 years, with a simple projected trendline for the next 2 years.

interesting_features.description: Data is presented at a much finer grain than ZIP code or city level — users can drill from city to census-tract to address. This progressive drill-down keeps the map uncluttered at high zoom and reveals detail on zoom-in.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a zoom-level-aware detail mode where the map automatically switches between city-level choropleth shading and block-level point data as the user zooms in and out.

interesting_features.description: All six data categories (crime, demographics, real estate, schools, economy, forecast) are surfaced in a single scrollable report per neighborhood rather than separate pages, allowing rapid side-by-side comparison without navigation.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a print/export button that generates a clean one-page PDF summary card for a selected neighborhood, including all displayed charts and key statistics.

similar_websites.name: CrimeGrade.org
similar_websites.what_it_does: A neighborhood safety grading site that uses machine learning to assign letter grades (A+ through F) for violent, property, and overall crime rates for every US neighborhood, with color-coded interactive maps and peer-city comparison tables.

interesting_features.feature: Letter-grade scoring system for crime categories
interesting_features.description: Instead of displaying raw crime rates alone, the platform converts them into familiar A–F letter grades for overall crime, violent crime, and property crime separately. This gives users an instantly scannable safety summary without needing to interpret per-capita statistics.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a letter-grade badge overlay on each neighborhood polygon on the map, and include a grades summary panel in the dashboard sidebar showing A–F scores for each data category (crime, income, demographics).

interesting_features.description: The interactive choropleth map has an explicit accessibility toggle that switches the color palette from red/green to a colorblind-safe scheme. This is a small but highly concrete UI enhancement.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an accessibility toolbar to the map with a colorblind-mode toggle that swaps the choropleth palette from the default green-to-red scale to a blue-to-orange colorblind-safe palette.

interesting_features.description: Below the map, the page shows two automatic comparison tables: one for nearby cities and one for cities with similar population sizes. This gives users context for whether a neighborhood's numbers are good or bad relative to peers, without manual searching.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an auto-generated peer comparison table below the main dashboard that lists the top 5 most similar-population neighborhoods from the dataset and shows their key stats side-by-side with the currently selected neighborhood.

interesting_features.feature: Projected crime cost breakdown (dollar value per resident)
interesting_features.description: Beyond rates, the platform converts crime frequency into an estimated annual financial cost per resident, breaking it down by crime type. This reframes abstract statistics into concrete personal impact numbers.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Economic Impact' panel to the data dashboard that translates the area's crime rate into an estimated annual cost-per-resident figure, displayed as a bar chart broken down by crime category.

app_short: Please implement a multi-company dashboard for managing and displaying financial data from multiple companies.

similar_websites.name: Joiin
similar_websites.what_it_does: A financial consolidation and reporting platform that lets businesses manage and consolidate financial data across multiple entities with live dashboards, automated intercompany eliminations, and multi-currency support.

interesting_features.description: Users can view a side-by-side comparison of budgeted figures against actual financial results for each company and at the consolidated group level, helping identify variances at a glance.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a budget vs. actual variance column to each company's financial table, highlighting over/under-budget rows in red or green.

interesting_features.description: Key Performance Indicators are surfaced as visual summary cards (e.g. gross margin %, revenue growth) on the dashboard so users can quickly gauge health without reading raw tables.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a row of KPI summary cards at the top of the dashboard showing metrics like total revenue, net profit margin, and YoY growth across all companies.

interesting_features.description: The platform flags and eliminates intercompany transactions (loans, internal sales) from consolidated reports so group-level totals are not double-counted.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an 'Intercompany Eliminations' section to the consolidated report that lists transactions between companies and shows the adjusted consolidated total after removing them.

interesting_features.description: Users can export branded report packs as PDF or Excel files for board presentations, giving offline access to consolidated financial data.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a CSV export button to each company's financial table and to the consolidated report so users can download the data for use in spreadsheets.

similar_websites.name: Fathom
similar_websites.what_it_does: A financial reporting and analysis platform for multi-entity businesses and accounting firms that provides consolidated reporting, group benchmarking, and cash flow forecasting with visual KPI tracking.

interesting_features.description: Fathom lets users visually compare and rank multiple companies or franchisees side by side on key metrics, making it easy to spot top and bottom performers across the portfolio.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a benchmarking table that ranks all companies by a selected metric (e.g. revenue, net profit) with sortable columns and color-coded performance indicators.

interesting_features.description: A single portfolio view lets accounting professionals see summary metrics for all clients at once and drill down into any individual company's detail without leaving the dashboard.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Make each company card on the dashboard clickable to expand an inline detail panel showing that company's full P&L breakdown without navigating away.

interesting_features.description: Reports can be scheduled to automatically generate and be delivered to stakeholders on a recurring basis, reducing manual effort for monthly or quarterly reporting cycles.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a date-range filter control to the dashboard so users can switch the displayed data between monthly, quarterly, and annual views with a single click.

interesting_features.feature: Cash Flow Forecasting with Scenario Planning
interesting_features.description: Users can model three-way forecasts (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and run what-if scenarios to see how changes in assumptions affect future financial outcomes.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a simple forecast toggle that projects the current period's revenue and expenses forward by 3 months using a linear trend, displayed as a dashed extension on the existing charts.

app_short: Please implement a sports analytics website that provides basketball betting data and analysis.

similar_websites.name: Dimers NBA Predictions
similar_websites.what_it_does: A data-driven NBA betting analytics platform that uses machine learning to generate real-time win probabilities, best bets, and player prop predictions for every game.

interesting_features.description: Allows users to combine multiple game predictions into a single multi-leg parlay ticket, showing the combined odds and probability of all legs hitting.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a parlay builder that lets users select multiple predicted games and calculates the combined payout odds for their parlay.

interesting_features.description: A dedicated section that surfaces only the top daily plays where the model's predicted probability diverges most from the implied odds, indicating the highest-value bets.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Best Bets' panel that automatically highlights the top 3 matchups where the predicted win probability most exceeds the implied odds from the betting line.

interesting_features.description: For each game, the platform shows the available moneyline, spread, and over/under odds from multiple sportsbooks side by side so users can find the best line.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an odds comparison row to each game card that displays the best available moneyline odds from multiple sportsbooks (e.g., DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM).

interesting_features.description: Provides player-level predictions for individual statistics (e.g., points, rebounds, assists) to help users bet on player props rather than just game outcomes.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a player props tab that shows predicted stat lines for key players in each game along with a comparison to the sportsbook over/under prop lines.

similar_websites.name: Odds Shark NBA Database
similar_websites.what_it_does: A historical NBA betting database that lets users filter past game results by team, date range, spread, and location to surface ATS records and over/under trends.

interesting_features.description: A dedicated filter that isolates games where a team is playing on the second night of a back-to-back, helping bettors understand how fatigue affects ATS performance.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Back-to-Back' badge to game cards and a filter toggle that highlights games where one or both teams are playing on zero days of rest.

interesting_features.description: Users can select two specific teams and query all historical head-to-head results, including ATS records and over/under outcomes between those two opponents.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a head-to-head history section to each matchup page that shows the last 10 meetings between the two teams, including the final score, spread result, and over/under result for each game.

interesting_features.description: Every team and game result shows not just the win/loss record but also the ATS record, giving bettors a quick view of how reliably a team covers the spread.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an ATS record column to the team rankings table that shows each team's against-the-spread record (e.g., 28-22 ATS) alongside their straight-up win-loss record.

interesting_features.description: Users can input a custom starting and ending spread value (e.g., only show games where the team was favored by 3-7 points) to analyze performance within specific betting scenarios.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a spread range slider to the match history table so users can filter past results to only show games played within a user-defined point spread range.

app_short: Please implement a dashboard website for displaying regulatory policies.

similar_websites.name: RegInfo.gov — OIRA Regulatory Dashboard
similar_websites.what_it_does: The official U.S. government dashboard for browsing and analyzing federal regulatory actions under review by the Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs (OIRA), with filtering by agency, rule stage, economic significance, and international impact.

interesting_features.feature: Multi-dimensional filter panel (agency, rule stage, economic significance, international impact)
interesting_features.description: Users can slice the full set of pending regulatory actions across several independent dimensions simultaneously, letting them quickly narrow to the subset of policies most relevant to them.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a multi-select filter sidebar so users can filter policies by category, status, and impact level at the same time.

interesting_features.description: A dedicated 'Top 10 Agencies' view ranks agencies by the volume of pending regulatory actions, giving a quick comparative leaderboard without leaving the dashboard.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a bar chart leaderboard panel that ranks policy categories or issuing agencies by the number of active policies.

interesting_features.description: A prominently displayed 'Total Pending Actions' counter gives users an immediate high-level snapshot before they dive into detail, making the dashboard feel actionable at a glance.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add summary KPI cards at the top of the dashboard showing total policies, number of recently added policies, and number expiring soon.

interesting_features.description: A dedicated page visualises the full lifecycle of how a regulation moves through the informal rulemaking process as an interactive flowchart, helping users understand where a policy sits in its journey.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a policy lifecycle timeline view that shows each policy's current stage in the rulemaking process as a step-progress indicator.

similar_websites.name: FDA Data Dashboard — Compliance Dashboards
similar_websites.what_it_does: A public-facing dashboard from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration that lets users explore compliance data — inspections, recalls, import refusals, and enforcement actions — with interactive charts and downloadable datasets.

interesting_features.description: Clicking on any bar, slice, or data point inside a chart automatically applies it as a filter to all other charts and tables on the page, so every view stays in sync without needing a separate filter form.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Make the dashboard charts interactive so clicking a segment in a pie or bar chart filters the policy table below to show only matching rows.

interesting_features.description: Users can download the currently-filtered subset of inspections, citations, or other records as an Excel file, making it easy to share or do offline analysis on exactly the data they were viewing.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a CSV/Excel export button that downloads the currently filtered and sorted policy table as a spreadsheet.

interesting_features.description: Selecting a row in the Inspections table automatically loads the associated regulatory citations in a second detail table below, enabling drill-down from a high-level inspection record to the specific rules violated.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a policy detail panel that slides open when a user clicks a row in the policy table, showing full description, associated citations, and a mini-chart of related metrics.

interesting_features.description: A glossary section on the dashboard page defines domain-specific terms (e.g., NAI/VAI/OAI classification codes) inline, so users without regulatory expertise can interpret the data without leaving the page.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add tooltip definitions that appear when hovering over policy status codes or category labels, explaining what each term means.

app_short: Please implement a solar dashboard to display real-time and historical solar data.

similar_websites.name: SolarEdge Monitoring Platform
similar_websites.what_it_does: A professional solar energy monitoring platform that displays real-time power flow, historical energy production/consumption data, and module-level performance for SolarEdge inverter systems.

interesting_features.description: A live animated diagram showing energy moving between solar panels, the home, the battery, and the grid in real time, giving an intuitive at-a-glance picture of where power is coming from and going.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an animated power flow diagram showing energy moving between solar panels, battery, home consumption, and grid import/export.

interesting_features.description: A CSV download button in the top-right of any data view lets users export the currently displayed data at the current time granularity for offline analysis in spreadsheet tools.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a CSV export button that downloads the currently displayed historical chart data for the selected date range.

interesting_features.description: Automated alerts are generated down to the individual panel level when performance drops or a fault is detected, with an alerts tab showing all active and historical alerts for any selected component.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an alerts/notifications panel that shows warning banners when solar output drops below a configurable threshold percentage.

interesting_features.description: Charts can be viewed at different time granularities (15-min intervals, hourly, daily, monthly, yearly) with a selector that adjusts the resolution of the historical chart automatically.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a time granularity selector (day/week/month/year) to the historical chart so users can zoom in and out on the data resolution.

similar_websites.name: Enact Solar Monitoring App
similar_websites.what_it_does: A solar monitoring web and mobile app that tracks real-time energy generation and consumption, compares actual versus estimated output, and calculates the financial payback period for a solar installation.

interesting_features.description: A chart overlay that plots actual measured solar generation against the originally estimated/predicted generation for the same period, letting users see at a glance if their system is over- or under-performing expectations.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an 'Actual vs. Expected' toggle on the historical chart that overlays a predicted generation baseline so users can see how much their system over- or under-performed.

interesting_features.description: A dedicated panel that calculates the solar investment payback period in months/years based on accumulated dollars saved from self-generated electricity, updating dynamically as more production data is recorded.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a savings summary card showing estimated money saved to date and projected payback period, based on a user-configurable electricity rate per kWh.

interesting_features.description: A prominent health/status badge on the dashboard that shows whether the system is operating normally, degraded, or offline, with color-coded indicators and notifications pushed when maintenance is needed.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a system status indicator badge (green/yellow/red) at the top of the dashboard that changes color based on whether current power generation is within a healthy range.

interesting_features.description: Historical charts support selecting and comparing energy generation across different periods (e.g., this month vs. last month, this year vs. last year) to identify seasonal trends or long-term degradation.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Compare periods' feature to the historical chart that lets users overlay the same date range from the previous month or year for side-by-side trend comparison.

app_short: Please develop a web-based Texas Hold'em poker game with features such as game lobby, table games, and chat functionality.

similar_websites.name: Kosmi Poker
similar_websites.what_it_does: A browser-based Texas Hold'em poker app that lets friends create private rooms and play together with integrated video chat.

interesting_features.description: Players can see and hear each other via webcam while playing poker at the same table, turning a text-only card game into a social face-to-face experience.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an emoji/reaction panel so players can send quick animated reactions (thumbs up, laughing face, shocked expression) during hands, as a lightweight alternative to full video chat.

interesting_features.feature: Shareable invite link for instant room joining
interesting_features.description: Room creators get a single URL they can paste anywhere to invite friends, removing the need for registration or friend lists before starting a game.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Copy invite link' button on the game lobby room card so the host can instantly share the room URL with a single click.

interesting_features.description: Room creators can set a password so only invited players can join, preventing strangers from entering a friends-only game.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an optional password field to the 'Create Room' form in the lobby, and show a lock icon on password-protected rooms in the room list.

similar_websites.name: Governor of Poker 3
similar_websites.what_it_does: A cross-platform Texas Hold'em poker game with multiple formats, social features, animated chat emoticons, and a progression system of achievements and badges.

interesting_features.description: Players can send animated emoji-style emoticons during a hand to bluff, taunt, or celebrate, adding a social and psychological layer to the game without requiring text chat.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a row of clickable animated emote buttons at the table (e.g., 'Thinking', 'Shocked', 'Laughing') that briefly display an animated icon above the player's seat when clicked.

interesting_features.description: Players earn XP, gold coins, badges, and trophies by completing specific in-game milestones (e.g., winning a hand with a bluff, going all-in), keeping users engaged across sessions.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an achievements panel to the player profile page that lists locked and unlocked badges with their completion criteria and a progress bar toward the next one.

interesting_features.description: Players receive a free stack of chips every few hours they can claim via a button, encouraging return visits without requiring any payment.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Claim Daily Bonus' button on the lobby page that awards the player a fixed chip amount once every 24 hours, with a countdown timer showing when the next bonus is available.

interesting_features.description: Beyond standard cash games, the lobby offers Sit & Go tournaments, Push-or-Fold, and other variants, giving players variety and letting different skill levels find appropriate formats.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Tournament' tab to the game lobby that lists scheduled Sit & Go tables with a fixed buy-in, a set number of players, and a prize pool breakdown shown before joining.

app_short: Please implement an online trivia contest app for hosting knowledge competitions.

similar_websites.name: Crowdpurr
similar_websites.what_it_does: A live trivia hosting platform that lets organizers run competitive quiz events for in-person, virtual, or hybrid audiences with real-time scoring and leaderboards.

interesting_features.description: Questions carry a countdown timer, and players earn more points for answering correctly sooner — rewarding both accuracy and speed.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a countdown timer to each question that reduces the point value the longer a player takes to answer.

interesting_features.description: Players who answer incorrectly are eliminated each round, creating a last-person-standing contest format that dramatically raises stakes.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an elimination mode where players who get a question wrong are knocked out of the contest and shown a 'You've been eliminated' screen.

interesting_features.description: Scores from multiple separate game sessions are linked together so a season-long or multi-event leaderboard can track cumulative performance over time.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a cumulative leaderboard that aggregates scores across all contests a user has participated in, not just the current one.

interesting_features.description: Hosts can export all participant answers and rankings to Excel or Google Sheets for offline review or record-keeping.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Download Results' button that exports the leaderboard and each player's answers as a CSV file.

similar_websites.name: TriviaMaker
similar_websites.what_it_does: An online trivia game creator and host platform offering seven interactive game formats, AI-generated questions, and live leaderboards for up to 2,000 simultaneous players.

interesting_features.description: Hosts can type any topic and the platform automatically generates a complete set of trivia questions, drastically lowering the barrier to creating new contests.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an 'Auto-generate questions' button on the contest creation form that accepts a topic and populates the question list using an AI API.

interesting_features.description: Questions are arranged in a Jeopardy-style grid by category and point value, letting players strategically choose which question to attempt next.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a category-selection screen at the start of each question round where players pick a category (e.g. Science, History, Sports) before the question is revealed.

interesting_features.description: Players enter a short numeric code to instantly join a live game without needing an account or app download, making enrollment frictionless.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a contest join flow where users can enter a 6-digit contest code on the home screen to jump directly into an active trivia session.

interesting_features.description: Players can be grouped into named teams whose individual scores are aggregated, enabling cooperative group play alongside individual leaderboards.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Create Team' option during contest enrollment so players can form or join a team, with a separate team leaderboard displayed alongside the individual one.

app_short: Please implement a chess web application where users can play chess online.

similar_websites.name: Chess.com
similar_websites.what_it_does: A comprehensive online chess platform where players can compete against humans or bots, complete puzzles, watch live events, and access structured lessons.

interesting_features.description: Players can challenge computer opponents that each have a distinct playing personality and style (e.g. aggressive, defensive, positional), not just a raw difficulty number. Each bot has a name, avatar, and a brief description of how it plays.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add named bot personalities to the computer opponent selector — for example 'Aggressive Anton' (prefers attacking play) and 'Solid Sofia' (defensive style) — instead of just difficulty levels 1-5.

interesting_features.description: A dedicated tactic puzzle mode where the board is shown mid-game and the player must find the best move. Correct/incorrect feedback is given immediately, and puzzle difficulty adapts to the player's rating.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Puzzle of the Day' section that presents a tactical position and asks the user to find the winning move, showing a success or failure message after they click a piece.

interesting_features.description: After a game ends, the platform replays the game move-by-move and annotates each move as brilliant, good, inaccuracy, mistake, or blunder, highlighting where the game turned.
interesting_features.followup_idea: After a game ends, add a 'Review Game' button that replays the move history one move at a time with forward/back arrows, highlighting the last moved piece on each step.

interesting_features.description: Players can choose from preset time control formats (Bullet 1+0, Blitz 3+2, Rapid 10+0, etc.) before starting a game, with a countdown clock displayed for both sides during play.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a chess clock to the game — a countdown timer for each player that starts ticking on their turn — with preset time controls (1 min, 3 min, 10 min) selectable before the game begins.

similar_websites.name: Lichess
similar_websites.what_it_does: A free, open-source online chess server offering multiplayer games, tournaments, tactical puzzles, an analysis board, and game import/export tools with no ads.

interesting_features.description: A drag-and-drop board editor lets players set up any custom starting position by placing pieces freely, then start a game or analysis from that position.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Custom Position' mode where the user can click pieces on and off the board to set up a custom starting position before starting a game against the computer.

interesting_features.description: An opening database panel shows the name of the current opening (e.g. 'Sicilian Defense, Najdorf Variation') as moves are played, along with win/draw/loss statistics for that line from master games.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Display the opening name (e.g. 'King's Pawn Opening', 'Sicilian Defense') in a label beneath the board as moves are played, updating it each time a recognized opening line is entered.

interesting_features.description: A blind mode replaces the graphical board with a text-based interface using algebraic notation input, making the game fully usable with a screen reader.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'High Contrast Mode' toggle in the board settings that switches piece icons to large, high-contrast symbols and increases the board square size for better visibility.

interesting_features.description: Players can paste a PGN (Portable Game Notation) string to import and replay any historical game, and can export their own completed games as a PGN file for use in other tools.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an 'Export PGN' button to the completed game screen that generates and downloads a standard PGN text file of all moves from the finished game.

app_short: Please implement a wheel of fortune website where users can spin the wheel to win prizes.

similar_websites.name: Picker Wheel
similar_websites.what_it_does: A free browser-based spinning wheel tool that lets users add custom entries, spin to get a random result, and track spin history across multiple sessions.

interesting_features.description: After a prize is won, it is removed from the wheel so it cannot be won again, useful for giveaways where each prize should only be awarded once.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add an elimination mode so that once a prize is won it is removed from the wheel and cannot be won again in subsequent spins.

interesting_features.description: Each prize can be assigned a numeric weight that controls the relative size of its slice on the wheel, allowing some prizes to be rarer than others.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Allow the admin to assign a rarity weight to each prize so that rarer prizes occupy a smaller slice of the wheel and are less likely to be landed on.

interesting_features.description: A complete log of every past spin is displayed alongside a running tally of how many times each prize has been won, giving users a clear record of all outcomes.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a spin history panel that shows every past spin result in a scrollable log, along with a count of how many times each prize has been won in total.

interesting_features.description: A unique URL is generated for the current wheel configuration so it can be shared with others who can open and spin the exact same wheel.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a share button that generates a unique URL encoding the current prize list so the wheel can be sent to friends who can spin the same configuration.

similar_websites.name: Wheel of Names
similar_websites.what_it_does: A customizable random name and prize picker wheel with rich audio, weighted segments, cloud storage, and live-streaming integration.

interesting_features.description: Users can choose from over 150 licensed music tracks and sound effects that play during and after a spin, enhancing the excitement of the result reveal.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a sound settings panel where users can toggle a spinning sound effect on or off and choose a victory jingle that plays when the wheel lands on a prize.

interesting_features.description: Users can join niche communities organized around specific topics (e.g. sports, politics, campus life) to filter posts to areas of interest rather than seeing everything.

interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a search results page with filters for category, date range, and keyword highlighting in matched documents.

interesting_features.description: All published leaks are organized under top-level subject categories (Intelligence, Corporations, War & Military, etc.), making it easy to browse by domain rather than just chronologically.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a category sidebar or tag system so submitted reports can be tagged with topics like 'Finance', 'Environment', or 'Government' and browsed by category.

interesting_features.feature: Tor-based anonymous submission with step-by-step security guide

interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'How to Stay Anonymous' info panel or modal on the submission form page that walks users through best practices for protecting their identity.

interesting_features.description: The homepage prominently displays recent major document releases with thumbnail images, short descriptions, and publication dates, acting as a news feed of the latest exposés.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a 'Featured Submissions' section on the homepage that an admin can pin to highlight the most impactful or verified reports.

similar_websites.name: GlobaLeaks

interesting_features.description: After submitting a report, the whistleblower receives a unique 16-digit receipt code. interesting_features.followup_idea: After a user submits an anonymous report, display a generated receipt code they can save. Add a 'Check submission status' page where entering the code shows replies or status updates from moderators.

interesting_features.description: Recipients (journalists, investigators) can send follow-up questions back to the whistleblower through the platform, and the whistleblower can respond, all within the encrypted, anonymous session.

interesting_features.description: Instead of a plain text box, submission forms use a configurable multi-step questionnaire with conditional fields (e.g. 'Is this about a public company?' triggers additional fields), ensuring structured, actionable reports.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Replace the single free-text submission form with a multi-step wizard that asks for report type, organization name, evidence description, and optional file upload across separate steps.

interesting_features.description: An admin-facing statistics panel shows aggregate metrics about submissions over time—total reports, reports by category, resolution rates—giving site operators insight into platform usage trends.

app_short: Please implement a Q&A website that answers user-submitted questions.

interesting_features.description: Every question is tagged with one or more topic labels (e.g. 'javascript', 'python'). Users can click a tag to filter all questions to that topic, making the site navigable by subject area.
interesting_features.followup_idea: Add a tag/category system where question submitters can pick a topic tag, and add a filter bar above the question list so visitors can filter questions by tag.

interesting_features.description: Answers and questions maintain a full edit history so any change can be reviewed and rolled back, and community members can suggest edits to improve content quality.
